description: This file defines the SalahHistoryAdapter class, which is a RecyclerView.Adapter used to display a list of SalahDayRecord items, showing the date and a summary of completed prayers, in an Android application related to Islamic prayer times.

classes.name: SalahHistoryAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView Adapter for displaying SalahDayRecord items in a list, including creating ViewHolders, binding data, and managing the item list.

classes.name: SalahHistoryAdapter.VH
classes.description: ViewHolder class that holds references to the views for each list item, specifically the date and summary TextViews.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Updates the internal list of records and notifies the adapter to refresh the displayed list.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the item layout and creates a new ViewHolder instance.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data from a SalahDayRecord to the ViewHolder views, including setting the date and a completion summary.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of items in the list.
